# grow-conversions.com

> CRO agency helping e-commerce, SaaS, and B2B businesses increase conversion rates through A/B testing, landing page design, and conversion copywriting. Founded 2018 by Mario Kuren, CRO specialist certified by CXL Institute and Google Analytics. Average 127% CVR lift across 50+ client engagements. Free 47-point audit for qualifying businesses.

## Services

- [Free CRO Audit](https://grow-conversions.com/services/cro-audit/): 47-point audit finds every conversion blocker and ranks fixes by revenue impact. Annotated screenshots and 90-day A/B test roadmap included. Genuinely free, no commitment.
- [A/B Testing](https://grow-conversions.com/services/ab-testing/): Hypothesis-driven testing with statistical rigor. Two-tailed z-tests, proper sample sizes, no peeking. Engagements start from €1,500/month.
- [Landing Page Design](https://grow-conversions.com/services/landing-page-design/): Psychology-focused page design built around specific offer, traffic source, and buyer intent.
- [Conversion Copywriting](https://grow-conversions.com/services/conversion-copywriting/): Headlines, CTAs, and email sequences built on voice-of-customer research.

## Case Studies

- [Filotea](https://grow-conversions.com/case-studies/filotea/): E-commerce CVR from 1.4% to 3.6% (+157%) — product page redesign and checkout optimisation over 90 days.
- [Forte Solar](https://grow-conversions.com/case-studies/forte-solar/): B2B lead gen CVR from 3.2% to 7.8% (+144%) — landing page rebuild with trust architecture and form optimisation.
- [Korak Ispred](https://grow-conversions.com/case-studies/korak-ispred/): Education enrolment CVR from 4.6% to 10.9% (+137%) — 19 friction points resolved over 8 weeks.
- [Lara Sweetland](https://grow-conversions.com/case-studies/lara-sweetland/): E-commerce CVR from 1.9% to 4.6% (+142%) — full CRO audit and implementation.

- [AB Testing Best Practices](https://grow-conversions.com/blog/ab-testing-best-practices/): Common mistakes, false positive prevention, and rigorous testing methodology.

## Free Tools (Interactive Calculators)

- [A/B Test Significance Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/ab-test-significance-calculator/): Two-tailed z-test — confidence level, p-value, and pass/fail verdict.
- [A/B Test Sample Size Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/ab-test-sample-size-calculator/): Minimum visitors per variant for a valid test.
- [A/B Test Duration Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/ab-test-duration-calculator/): Days required; enforces 14-day minimum.
- [Conversion Rate Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/conversion-rate-calculator/): CVR from conversions and visitors, with revenue impact.
- [Checkout Funnel Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/checkout-funnel-calculator/): Step-by-step drop-off analysis and biggest revenue leak.
- [Cart Abandonment Rate Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/cart-abandonment-rate-calculator/): Abandonment rate and monthly revenue lost.
- [CRO ROI Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/cro-roi-calculator/): Monthly and annual revenue impact of CVR improvements.
- [Landing Page ROI Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/landing-page-roi-calculator/): CPA, ROAS, and CVR improvement scenarios.
- [Customer Lifetime Value Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/customer-lifetime-value-calculator/): CLV, max profitable CAC, and retention sensitivity.
- [Form Conversion Calculator](https://grow-conversions.com/tools/form-conversion-calculator/): Form start vs. completion rate and revenue impact.
